'''Ilain Dormaile''' is a [[banker]] in [[Tar Valon]]. She is Cairhienin, as stated by [[Moiraine Damodred]], since the Dormaile banker family took care of her money already in Cairhien.

==Appearance==
Mistress Dormaile is a slim woman with graying hair. She is [[Measurement|a hand]] shorter than Moiraine Damodred.{{ref/book|0|13}}

==History==
When Moiraine Damodred is raised to the [[shawl]], she visits Ilain Dormaile to deposit her stipend from the [[White Tower]]. Mistress Dormaile tells Moiraine of a man, [[Ries Gorthanes]], who tried prying into Moiraine's affairs.{{ref/book|0|13}} When Moiraine leaves the Tower, she goes to Ilain's bank and withdrawls gold and several letters-of-rights.{{ref/book|0|14}} One of these is then later cashed with [[Kamile Noallin]] in [[Chachin]].{{ref/book|0|24}}
